title: Admin
about: The co-founders. They guide NISC, manage the team and keep the community’s website and groups running.
responsibilities: Manage the team and new members
Run the website and community groups
Represent NISC with colleges and partners

title: Tech Lead
about: Leads technical content, member projects and NISC’s digital tools.
responsibilities: Guide member projects and code quality

title: Community Lead
about: Keeps members connected and makes every new student feel welcome.
responsibilities: Look after the community groups and channels
Bring students from different colleges together

title: Content / Design Lead
about: Owns how NISC looks: posters, social graphics and the visual identity.
responsibilities: Design event posters and social graphics

title: Operations / Events Lead
about: Plans and runs sessions, workshops and meetups from start to finish.

title: Content Lead / Editor
about: Writes and edits what NISC publishes, so every message is clear and accurate.
responsibilities: Check facts before anything is published
Keep the website content up to date
